actions.name: stench
actions.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=6e3MrenfD7Q2nBLE]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be &reference[poisoned] until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for 24 hours.

actions.name: turn defiance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and any @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.OBujQLLPSmlJiZnL]{ghouls} within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: claws
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature other than an undead, it must succeed on a [[/save activity=GKEI5W17dgV81huq]] saving throw or be &reference[paralyzed] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=GKEI5W17dgV81huq]]. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
